issue.title: [Enhancement] Allow searching for aws_secretsmanager_secret via tag values
issue.body:
### Description

The current aws_secretsmanager_secret data source requires specifying a name or ARN of the secret.

Please add the ability to use tags to find the secret instead like other data sources do (e.x. `aws_lb`, `aws_subnet`, and `aws_instance`)

I see some sources use the `tags` configuration for lookup while others use `filter` blocks. I would prefer the `tags` method but I'm not sure the standard being used going forward.

### Affected Resource(s) or Data Source(s)

* `data.aws_secretsmanager_secret`

### Potential Terraform Configuration

```hcl
data "aws_secretsmanager_secret" "ExampleLogin" {
  tags = {
    CredentialsFor = "auth.example.com"
  }
}
```


### References

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/apireference/API_ListSecrets.html#API_ListSecrets_RequestParameters

API uses `filters` for tags

### Would you like to implement the enhancement?

No
